full_prompt_en: A square brightly lit three-dimensional cartoon scene shows a small boylike robot riding a rounded red rocket through the sky. The figure sits astride the rocket near its middle, high above soft white clouds. His large head has black hair gathered into two pointed tufts, a pale round face, oversized gray eyes, small ears, and an open delighted mouth. He wears a short-sleeved pale shirt, blue shorts, and brown shoes. One hand grips the top of the rocket for balance while the other arm reaches up in an open-palmed wave. The rocket points toward the left foreground, so its cream nose cone and circular blue glass-like front occupy the lower left. Its glossy red body swells into rounded side pods, silver seams, and small fins. A thick white vapor trail rolls back and down to the right, visually joining the large cumulus clouds. The sky is clear saturated blue overhead and grows paler toward the clouds. Sunlight from the upper left and front gives the boy's face and hands a warm glow and places smooth highlights on the red painted shell. The camera looks slightly upward, increasing the sense of flight and letting the rocket project toward the viewer. The composition balances the little rider near the top against the heavier vehicle below. Material textures are polished but gently toy-like: soft skin, smooth plastic or painted metal, and fluffy cloud vapor. The pose conveys joy rather than danger. There are no other people, buildings, or readable words. Bright color, round proportions, and a clear silhouette make the flying figure immediately legible even amid the luminous clouds.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形明亮三维卡通场景描绘一名小小的机器人男孩乘坐圆润红火箭飞过天空。人物骑坐在火箭中段，下面是柔白云层。大头顶着两束尖起黑发，浅色圆脸、大大的灰眼、小耳朵和张开的开心笑口。他穿浅色短袖、蓝短裤与棕鞋。一只手抓住火箭顶部保持平衡，另一只手高举，摊开掌心挥手。火箭指向左前方，所以奶油色鼻锥与圆形蓝色玻璃般前窗占据左下。发亮红机身鼓起圆形侧舱，带银色拼缝和小尾翼。厚白蒸汽尾迹向右下滚去，视觉上连入大块积云。天空上方是清透饱和蓝，靠近云层渐浅。左上和前方的阳光温暖孩子脸与手，在红漆外壳上留下平滑亮斑。镜头略向上看，增强飞行感，让火箭朝观者伸来。构图把上方小乘客与下方较重的载具平衡。材质精致又带柔和玩具感：平滑皮肤、光洁塑料或漆金属，以及蓬松云汽。姿势表达快乐而非危险。没有其他人、建筑或可读字。亮色、圆比例和清楚剪影使飞行人物即使在发光云团中也立即可辨。
style_prompt_en: A buoyant three-dimensional cartoon finish combines rounded toy proportions with polished, gently reflective surfaces. Saturated sky blue, glossy red, cream, and warm skinlike tones sit above large soft white cloud masses. Strong daylight produces clean highlights and mild shadows without flattening the forms. The camera's slightly low angle makes a bulbous front volume project toward the viewer, while a curling vapor shape carries movement diagonally across the background. Large expressive facial marks remain simple and readable; small seams and fittings add material detail without visual clutter. Silhouettes are clear, edges are smooth, and the palette stays optimistic and airy. Soft atmospheric cloud rendering contrasts with hard glossy shell surfaces, giving the scene both tactile variety and lighthearted speed.
style_prompt_zh: 轻快的三维卡通完成度把圆润玩具比例与抛光而温和反光的表面结合。饱和天空蓝、亮红、奶油色与暖肤色位于大块柔白云团之上。强日光形成干净高光与轻微阴影，而不压平形体。略低的镜头让鼓起的前部体积朝观者伸出，卷曲蒸汽形在背景斜向带出运动。大而有表情的面部记号保持简单可读，细小拼缝和配件补充材质信息却不杂乱。剪影清楚，边缘圆滑，色盘乐观轻盈。柔软空气云朵与坚硬发亮外壳对比，带来多样触感和愉快速度。
theme_en: A cheerful small black-haired robot boy rides a red rocket above sunlit clouds
theme_zh: 快乐的黑发机器人男孩乘红色火箭飞越日光云海
name: Astro Boy
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
